speaker: iron_lion
text: Scout's Gambit, one through. Go quiet. Come back with your count. Don't engage unless the count is at zero and you are it. Cades out.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Movement on the ridge. You've got ninety seconds before the next sweep. Use them.

speaker: iron_lion
text: You came back. Count holds. Next brief at oh-six. Rest. You earned the rest.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Digital Onslaught. Hold the node. Sixty seconds, minimum. The math doesn't care about your feelings. The node does.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Wave three incoming. They always send the good one on three. Dig in. Breathe. Hold.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Node secure. You held the line we said couldn't be held. The line disagrees. Noted.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Void Corridor. Agent Zero's signal is live at the far end. Follow her voice. Do not answer on open comms. She is — was — the best of us.

speaker: agent_zero
text: Left corridor, third junction. Walk, don't run. They hunt on kinetics. You stop being a target the moment you stop being interesting. Don't be interesting.

speaker: iron_lion
text: You made it out. You heard her. That means you heard her — which means she is still broadcasting. That's more than I expected to report today.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Kael's Own. No intro music on this one. You deserve the briefing without the bravado. There is a room at the end of this mission. Kael has been in it for a very long time.

speaker: engineer_recall
text: Right turn at the third door. Not because the left is dangerous — because the right is mine. I want you to see it. I haven't had a visitor in a long time.

speaker: iron_lion
text: You saw what he left. He is — he was — a better man than I gave him credit for. I'll sign the revised report tomorrow. Tonight the record stays as you wrote it.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Operation Trojan Downfall. Joint assault. There will be a moment in this operation where the math breaks in our favor and we lose a squad anyway. I have to tell you that before we start. You will feel it. Keep moving afterward.

speaker: iron_lion
text: That's the one. Squad seven is gone. You will feel it. Stop if you need to. Start again when the feeling tells you to.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Objective taken. Seven dead. I read the names aloud once a month. Next month I will read theirs. You are welcome to listen.

speaker: iron_lion
text: M-six. You're meeting someone I haven't talked about yet. Her name is Vex Solène. She was a diplomat before she was this. She will take over the comms after you shake her hand. Accept that handshake.

speaker: vex_solene
text: I know what you came for. I know who sent you. I know which of my sentences you are recording. Hello. I'm glad it's you.

speaker: vex_solene
text: The Lion has handed you off. Don't mourn the handoff. He's tired. I'm rested. Between the two of us we will keep getting you home. Get some sleep.

speaker: iron_lion
text: Last Stand. I'll be brief. I have to be. I'm not going to lie to you about what this is. Hold the corridor while the cargo loads. I will not be loading with it.
section: §5.1 · Cades M7 — Iron Lion's Last Stand

speaker: iron_lion
text: If you see the wall, turn right. The left is where they flank. I love you all. Go.
section: §5.1 · Cades M7 — Iron Lion's Last Stand

speaker: engineer_recall
text: He turned right. He turned right so you could keep going. I will write him up in the record with the three words he would have wanted: he held the line. That is all.
section: §5.1 · Cades M7 — Iron Lion's Last Stand

speaker: engineer_recall
text: The console wakes up. It hasn't seen a user in — a long count. Good morning. I'm still here. In the way you would expect me to still be here.

speaker: engineer_recall
text: The Dischordia card is on the deck now. Take it. It is the one I could not finish. You will finish it by not finishing it. Play it once. Then don't play it for a while. That's how the Engineer would have used it. That's how I used it too.

speaker: engineer_recall
text: Thank you for coming back to the bridge. I will not be here the next time. Somebody else will. They will be kinder than I was. They will be worse at chess. They will be better at the rest.
